load_data_training: load training data for a scaling law task from the Hugging Face Hub repository
load_data_testing: load test data for a scaling law task from the Hugging Face Hub repository
load_data_sft: load sft scaling law data with sft_data_size features and sft_loss targets
load_data_moe: load moe scaling law data with num_experts and dense_parameter_count features
load_data_all_tasks: load and inspect data shapes for all eight scaling law tasks in the schema
